title: Indiana Dunes Is America’s Newest National Park
titleZh: 印第安纳沙丘是美国最新的国家公园
credits: Erika Celeste reported this story for VOA News. Ashley Thompson adapted it for VOA Learning English, using earlier Learning English reports by Jerilyn Watson. Kelly Jean Kelly was the editor.

sentences.en: More than 3.5 million people visit a sandy, hilly area called Indiana Dunes each year.
sentences.zh: 每年有超过350万人游览一片名为印第安纳沙丘的沙滩与丘陵地带。

sentences.en: It sits along the shores of Lake Michigan, about 80 kilometers southeast of Chicago, Illinois.
sentences.zh: 它位于密歇根湖沿岸，在伊利诺伊州芝加哥东南约80公里处。

sentences.en: Visitors to the area swim and sail on the lake.
sentences.zh: 游客在湖中游泳、扬帆航行。

sentences.en: They watch birds in the wetlands.
sentences.zh: 他们在湿地观鸟。

sentences.en: They study plant life in the forests of oak and maple trees.
sentences.zh: 他们研究橡树和枫树林中的植物。

sentences.en: Now, the 6,000-hectare site is the newest national park in the United States.
sentences.zh: 如今，这片占地6000公顷的景区成为美国最新的国家公园。

sentences.en: It became Indiana Dunes National Park in February.
sentences.zh: 今年二月，它正式成为印第安纳沙丘国家公园。

sentences.en: Among the first to visit the new park were Bill and Betty Smith.
sentences.zh: 首批游览这座新公园的人中就有比尔和贝蒂·史密斯夫妇。

sentences.en: They traveled from Connecticut to the state of Indiana, where the park is located.
sentences.zh: 他们从康涅狄格州来到公园所在的印第安纳州。

sentences.en: The two said they had already visited all 60 of the country’s other national parks.
sentences.zh: 这两人说，他们此前已经游遍了该国其余60个国家公园。

sentences.en: Bill Smith said he was excited to see the sand dunes in person.
sentences.zh: 比尔·史密斯说他很兴奋能亲眼看到沙丘。

sentences.en: He also wanted to explore some of the park’s 80 kilometers of hiking paths.
sentences.zh: 他还想探索公园部分长达80公里的徒步小径。

sentences.en: “I just want to get a sense of the place,” he said of America’s 61st national park.
sentences.zh: “我只想感受一下这个地方”，他说，指的正是美国第61个国家公园。

sentences.en: Strong winds from Lake Michigan -- one of America’s five so-called Great Lakes -- created the park’s sand dunes over time.
sentences.zh: 来自密歇根湖的强风——美国五大湖之一——经过漫长岁月塑造了公园的沙丘。

sentences.en: Some dunes are still forming today.
sentences.zh: 有些沙丘至今仍在形成。

sentences.en: The winds create the dunes by dropping loose sand onto land.
sentences.zh: 风将松散的沙子落到地上，从而形成沙丘。

sentences.en: Some of the dunes here look partly round.
sentences.zh: 这里的有些沙丘看起来呈半圆形。

sentences.en: Others take the form of long, narrow hills.
sentences.zh: 另一些则形成长而窄的山丘。

sentences.en: The smooth sands of the dunes and lakeshore make an almost musical sound when people walk on them.
sentences.zh: 当人们走在上面时，沙丘和湖畔光滑的沙子会发出近乎音乐般的声音。

sentences.en: The sounds can sometimes be heard several meters away.
sentences.zh: 这些声音有时能在数米之外被听到。

sentences.en: Visitors like to say that the sand dunes “sing.”
sentences.zh: 游客们喜欢说这些沙丘会“歌唱”。

sentences.en: It has been a long, hard fight to get Indiana Dunes designated as a national park.
sentences.zh: 印第安纳沙丘被指定为国家公园，这是一场漫长而艰辛的斗争。

sentences.en: The park’s superintendent, Paul Labovitz, said the process was “103 years in the making.”
sentences.zh: 公园的园长保罗·拉博维茨表示，这一过程“历时103年”。

sentences.en: The idea was first proposed in 1916 -- the same year the National Park Service was established.
sentences.zh: 这一想法最早在1916年被提出——也就是国家公园管理局成立的那一年。

sentences.en: But World War I and the need for steel mills on the lakefront to support the war effort delayed such plans for the park.
sentences.zh: 但第一次世界大战以及湖畔钢铁厂为支持战争努力的需求，推迟了为该公园制定的此类计划。

sentences.en: Later efforts to get the national park designation were halted by industrialization of the nearby Port of Indiana, the largest commercial port on Lake Michigan.
sentences.zh: 后来，为了将该地区提升为国家公园的努力，因附近的印第安纳港工业化而受阻，这是密歇根湖上最大的商业港口。

sentences.en: More recently, Indiana lawmakers presented the idea to Congress in 2017 and 2018.
sentences.zh: 最近，印第安纳州的立法者在2017年和2018年将这一想法提交给了国会。

sentences.en: But no action was taken.
sentences.zh: 但没有采取任何行动。

sentences.en: It took the longest-ever government shutdown in American history to bring about change for Indiana Dunes, says Lorelei Weimer.
sentences.zh: 洛雷莱·魏梅尔说，美国历史上历时最长的政府停摆促成了印第安纳沙丘的改变。

sentences.en: She is the park’s director of tourism.
sentences.zh: 她是该公园的旅游总监。

sentences.en: She said that one Indiana congressman was able to include the measure into the new legislation in January.
sentences.zh: 她说，有一位印第安纳州的国会议员成功地将这一措施纳入了新的立法之中。

sentences.en: U.S. lawmakers were rushed to pass the funding bill in order to reopen the government.
sentences.zh: 美国立法者匆忙通过拨款法案，以重新开放政府。

sentences.en: Weimer said, “The fact that (the Indiana lawmaker) was able to get it into the budget bill was a huge win for us.”
sentences.zh: 魏梅尔说：“（印第安纳州议员）能够把它纳入预算法案，这对我们来说是一个巨大的胜利。”

sentences.en: The designation came as a surprise to Weimer and many others.
sentences.zh: 这一指定让魏梅尔和许多人感到意外。

sentences.en: She said, “None of us knew that was going to happen.”
sentences.zh: 她说：“我们没有人知道会发生这样的事情。”

sentences.en: The designation does not come with any new rules or big financial changes for Indiana Dunes.
sentences.zh: 这一指定并不会给印第安纳沙丘带来任何新的规则或重大的财政变化。

sentences.en: It does, however, give the area the same recognition as more well-known national parks like Yellowstone and Yosemite.
sentences.zh: 然而，它确实让该地区获得了与黄石和优胜美地等更著名的国家公园相同的认可。

sentences.en: The U.S. National Park Service system includes more than 400 parks, monuments, historic sites and other protected areas.
sentences.zh: 美国国家公园管理局系统包括400多个公园、纪念碑、历史遗迹和其他保护区。

sentences.en: For many years, Indiana Dunes was a national lakeshore within the park system. ​
sentences.zh: 在许多年里，印第安纳沙丘曾是公园系统内的一个国家级湖滨区。

sentences.en: Park Superintendent Labovitz called the park one of the most ecologically mixed places in North America.
sentences.zh: 公园园长拉博维茨称该公园是北美生态最多样化的地方之一。

sentences.en: Indiana Dunes has about 1,500 different kinds of plants, he said.
sentences.zh: 印第安纳沙丘大约有1500种植物，他说。

sentences.en: The Dunes are also along a major migration path, and birdwatching is a big reason visitors come to Indiana Dunes each year.
sentences.zh: 这些沙丘也位于一条主要迁徙通道上，观鸟是游客每年来到印第安纳沙丘的一个重要原因。

sentences.en: The area is home to more than 300 species of birds, including waterbirds such as loons and herons, as well as birds of prey like bald eagles and hawks.
sentences.zh: 该地区有300多种鸟类栖息，包括潜鸟和鹭等水鸟，以及白头鹰和鹰等猛禽。

sentences.en: Several species of songbirds also live there.
sentences.zh: 几种鸣禽也生活在那里。

sentences.en: Weimer said people from about 50 countries visit the park each year.
sentences.zh: 魏梅尔说，每年约有50个国家的游客参观这座公园。

sentences.en: The park offers guidebooks in 12 languages.
sentences.zh: 公园提供12种语言的指南。

sentences.en: “This is not just a local attraction,” Weimer said of the park.
sentences.zh: “这不仅仅是一个本地景点，”魏梅尔谈到这座公园时说。

sentences.en: “It’s an international attraction.”
sentences.zh: “它是一个国际性景点。”

sentences.en: I'm Caty Weaver.
sentences.zh: 我是凯蒂·韦弗。

sentences.en: And I’m Ashley Thompson.
sentences.zh: 我是阿什利·汤普森。
